items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, the jelly roll blues. King Porter, did he know? [INTERVIEWEE] He hesitated, must have hesitated.

ctx.x: the pearls and the jelly roll blues and the whining boy.
Yeah, the jelly roll blues. King Porter, did he know?
He hesitated, must have hesitated. And I used to use that in the show, you remember?
